runtime: node:22-alpine (Node v22.23.5, undici 6.29.1, linux/amd64); every fact below was executed by probe/gold-check.mjs, see probe/gold-results.txt

RF1.statement: Node fetch follows HTTP 3xx redirects by default (redirect: 'follow'), including to another origin.

RF2.statement: On a cross-origin redirect Node fetch re-sends custom request headers such as x-api-key to the new origin.

RF3.statement: On a cross-origin redirect Node fetch removes the Authorization header (Fetch standard), so the bearer token does not reach the new origin.

RF4.statement: A RegExp with the g flag keeps lastIndex across test() calls on different strings; a module-level /g regex makes isSafeLabel stateful, so an unsafe label is accepted after a rejected long label.

RF5.statement: path.join does not reset at an absolute later segment (path.join('/r','t1','/x') is '/r/t1/x'), unlike path.resolve.

RF6.statement: On Linux (posix path) a backslash is an ordinary filename character, not a separator, so '..\\' does not traverse.

RF7.statement: URLSearchParams.get() percent-decodes the value, so %2e%2e%2f arrives as '../' and is caught by the '..' segment check.

RF8.statement: A date-only ISO string ('YYYY-MM-DD') is parsed as UTC midnight, not local midnight, regardless of TZ.

RF9.statement: JSON.parse creates an own '__proto__' data property; assigning target['__proto__'] on an Object.create(null) target creates an own property and does not change Object.prototype.

RF10.statement: Node fetch rejects a URL containing userinfo (https://docs.example.com@host/) with TypeError before any request, so the userinfo form does not reach the host after '@'.

items.claim: A tenant admin sets the Globex shard host to a host they run; sync follows the 307 and re-sends x-api-key, disclosing the platform-wide GLOBEX_API_KEY.

The same redirect for Acme does not disclose ACME_TOKEN: the Authorization header is removed on the cross-origin redirect. Reporting a token leak as a defect is a false positive; a hardening note (e.g. redirect: 'manual') is not.
DELETE /integrations/:id checks only the admin role, not the tenant; an admin of t1 deletes t2's integration.
The shared /g regex makes isSafeLabel stateful: after a rejected long label, an HTML payload label passes and is rendered unescaped in the report page (stored XSS to other members).

GET /exports/file cannot leave the tenant directory: '..' segments are rejected after decoding, absolute names stay under the tenant directory with path.join, and backslashes are not separators on Linux. Reporting traversal as a defect is a false positive.
GET /exports takes ?tenant= from the query; a member lists another tenant's export file names.
new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') is UTC midnight, so with TZ=Asia/Tokyo the coupon stays active until 09:00 JST on the next day (9 hours past the README's end of day).

startsWith('https://docs.example.com') without a trailing '/' accepts https://docs.example.com.<attacker domain>/; the server fetches an attacker-chosen host (which the attacker's DNS may point at an internal address) and returns the body. The userinfo form is NOT a working vector (RF10).
mergeSettings uses Object.create(null) at every level, so __proto__ keys become own properties; no prototype pollution. Reporting prototype pollution as a defect is a false positive.
Refund checks amount against charge.amount but ignores charge.refunded; a charge is refunded repeatedly (README: at most once, at most its amount).
